body:
🏰 UltimateLandClaim

> The Ultimate Dual-Mode Land Protection Plugin for Paper 1.21.x

UltimateLandClaim is a modern land claiming plugin that combines the best features of Towny, Factions, and GriefPrevention into one powerful solution.

Choose between **Chunk Claiming** or **Freeform Claiming**, protect your builds, manage player trust, earn claim blocks through playtime, and switch claiming modes without losing existing claims.

---

 ✨ Features

- 📦 Dual Claim Modes
  - Chunk Claiming
  - Freeform Rectangle Claiming
- 🔄 Switch modes anytime without data loss
- 🛡 Advanced land protection
- 👥 4-Level Trust System
- 💰 Playtime Claim Block Economy
- 🎨 Particle Claim Borders
- 🌍 WorldGuard Integration
- 📊 PlaceholderAPI Support
- 🏘 Towny Compatibility
- 🌐 Multi-language Support
- ⚙ Fully Configurable
- ⚡ Built for Paper 1.21.x

---

 📦 Claim Modes

 CHUNK Mode

Perfect for:

- Town Servers
- Factions
- SMPs

Features:

- One-click chunk claiming
- Fixed claim cost
- 16×16 chunk protection
- Auto Claim support

---

 FREE Mode

Perfect for:

- Survival
- Creative
- Custom builds

Features:

- Select two corners
- Custom-sized claims
- Area-based cost
- Block-perfect protection

---

 🔄 Mode Switching

UltimateLandClaim stores all claims using a universal system.

You can freely switch between **CHUNK** and **FREE** mode through the configuration without deleting existing claims.

---

 🛡 Protection

Protects:

- Blocks
- Chests
- Barrels
- Furnaces
- Hoppers
- Doors
- Gates
- Buttons
- Levers
- Redstone Components

Additional protection:

- PvP Toggle
- Explosion Protection
- Mob Grief Prevention

---

 👥 Trust Levels

| Level | Permissions |
|--------|-------------|
| ACCESS | Doors, Buttons, Levers |
| CONTAINER | Access + Containers |
| BUILD | Container + Build |
| MANAGER | Full claim management |

Example:

```text
/claim trust Steve BUILD
```

---

 💰 Claim Block Economy

Players earn claim blocks simply by playing.

Features:

- Starting Claim Blocks
- Claim Blocks Per Minute
- Maximum Claim Blocks
- Full Refund on Claim Deletion

Everything is configurable.

---

 🎨 Visual Features

- Particle Borders
- Live Claim Visualization
- Distance Optimized
- Minimal Performance Impact

Hold a **Stick** to view nearby claim borders.

---

 🌍 Integrations

Supported plugins:

- ✅ WorldGuard
- ✅ PlaceholderAPI
- ✅ Towny

All integrations are optional.

---

 📜 Commands

 Player

```text
/claim
/claim trust <player> <level>
/claim untrust <player>
/claim info
/claim list
/claim auto
/claim delete

/unstuck
```

 Admin

```text
/ulc
/ulc reload
/ulc language <code>

/ulc admin
/ulc admin <player>

/ulc deleteclaim <player>
/ulc deleteclaim <player> <id>

/ulc migrate all
/ulc migrate player <player>
/ulc migrate preview
/ulc migrate status
/ulc migrate reset
```

---

 🔐 Permissions

 Player

```text
ultimatelandclaim.claim
ultimatelandclaim.unstuck
```

 Admin

```text
ultimatelandclaim.admin
ultimatelandclaim.reload
ultimatelandclaim.language
ultimatelandclaim.bypass

ultimatelandclaim.admin.delete
ultimatelandclaim.admin.gui
ultimatelandclaim.admin.player
ultimatelandclaim.admin.migrate
```

 Bonus Claim Blocks

```text
ultimatelandclaim.bonus.100
ultimatelandclaim.bonus.500
ultimatelandclaim.bonus.1000
```

 Wildcard

```text
ultimatelandclaim.*
```

 PlaceholderAPI

UltimateLandClaim supports PlaceholderAPI.

**Placeholder Prefix**
```text
%ultimatelandclaim_<placeholder>%
```

---

 ⚙ Configuration

Choose your preferred claim mode:

```yaml
claim-mode: CHUNK
```

Example:

```yaml
economy:
  starting-claim-blocks: 100
  claim-blocks-per-minute: 1
  max-claim-blocks: 10000

protection:
  allow-pvp: false
  allow-explosions: false
  prevent-mob-damage: true
```

---

 📥 Installation

1. Download `UltimateLandClaim.jar`
2. Place it inside your `plugins` folder.
3. Start the server.
4. Configure `config.yml`.
5. Run `/ulc reload`.

---

 📋 Requirements

- Paper 1.21.1+
- Java 21+

---

 ❓ FAQ

 Can I switch claim modes later?

Yes. Existing claims remain intact.

 Does it support WorldGuard?

Yes. Integration is automatic if WorldGuard is installed.

 Does it require PlaceholderAPI?

No. It is optional.

 Does it support MySQL?

Not currently. Version 1.0 stores data in YAML files.
